recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, gritty composition featuring analog audio equipment elements like knobs and VU meters, overlaid with aggressive horizontal red light streaks and a prominent, boxed typographic lockup in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: Red horizontal light streaks cutting through dark, desaturated imagery
Strict geometric text boxes contrasting with organic film grain and motion blur
Analog hardware details providing a technical, industrial foundation
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white base photography
Vibrant, saturated red as the sole accent color
Heavy film grain and digital noise texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary typographic block is anchored in the upper left quadrant, while a circular audio component acts as a secondary visual weight in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white-on-black and black-on-white text box in the top left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the high-contrast text box, follows the horizontal red streaks across the center, and settles on the circular hardware detail below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows occupy the lower left and upper right, creating a sense of depth and mystery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and charcoal grey provide the background and shadow depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white is used for primary text and highlights on hardware.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vivid red creates horizontal energy and motion blur effects.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white, with high saturation limited to the red light effects.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family variation using inverted color blocks for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Matches the clean, industrial sans-serif aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, industrial background featuring a close-up of analog audio knobs and a circular speaker or lens element. Apply heavy film grain and three horizontal, glowing red light streaks across the middle third of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a three-tiered rectangular box in the top left. The top and bottom tiers should be black outlines with white text; the middle tier should be a solid white box with black text. Use an extra-condensed bold sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the red vibrant and saturated?
Is the text extra-condensed and uppercase?
Is there a heavy grain texture across the whole image?
Are the boxes perfectly rectangular and aligned?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red light streaks
Specific hardware components in the background

mustAchieve: Sense of motion through red streaks

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast black and white balance
Ensure red streaks appear as light motion, not solid bars
Verify typography is legible despite the condensed nature
Confirm the presence of analog hardware details
